# VPN Kill Switch (Windows Edition)

A lightweight utility that monitors your public IP and immediately disables network adapters if an IP leak is detected.

---

## 1. Prerequisites
Ensure Python 3.8+ is installed on Windows.
- Make sure to check **Add python.exe to PATH** during Python installation.

---

## 2. Installation (Recommended)
1. Right-click `Install_Windows.bat` and select **Run as administrator**.
2. Shortcuts with icons will be created on your **Desktop** and **Start Menu**.

---

## 3. Portable Usage (Without Install)
Right-click `Run_Directly.bat` and select **Run as administrator**.

---

## 4. Uninstallation
Right-click `Uninstall_Windows.bat` and select **Run as administrator**.
